children.value: > Fact From Story: The DOJ has been investigating Apple for years over the company’s policy for third-party apps on its devices and whether it unfairly favors its own products.
> > Fact From Story: There’s an ongoing case between the FTC and Facebook, wherein the agency calls on Facebook to sell Instagram and WhatsApp.
> > Fact From Story: The FTC sued Amazon in September for using anticompetitive and unfair strategies to illegally maintain its monopoly power.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Government investigations and lawsuits are methods to regulate companies.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Government investigations involve scrutinizing a company's practices.
